_comment: CIS Microsoft Intune for Office Benchmark v1.1.0, Level 1: the core macro and active-content subset the owner approved on 2026-10-26 ("macro core"), judged by INT-2.6 against the assigned Intune Settings Catalog policies (including the Microsoft 365 Apps security baseline) that configure Office. Recommendation numbers and setting names only: the benchmark text is licensed and is not reproduced. Each requirement (Enabled or Disabled, and the VBA notification option) is the benchmark's; the setting names and the meaning of each state come from Microsoft's Office policy documentation (Source). A setting is matched by its app (the ADMX namespace in the Settings Catalog definition id, e.g. user_vendor_msft_policy_config_excel16v2~...) and by the definition's display name as Graph returns it, or the ADMX policy name at the end of the id (Node, best effort: Microsoft publishes no Graph sample of the Office ids). Enabled and Disabled are read from the option's display name first and the _1/_0 suffix of the choice value second; the VBA option only by its display name. NotInApprovedSubset names the macro-adjacent Level 1 recommendations the approved subset leaves out, with the reason; the rest of the benchmark is outside this control. The standard applies only while Config/tp-standards.json IntuneOfficeMacroBaseline approves this benchmark and version. Testing/TP.IntuneTruth.Tests.ps1 pins this file.
